title: D3: do less-closed concepts graft more later? (concept-level, one mechanism at two scales)
timing_level_rule: first of L1..L4 with >= 80 screen MAIN concepts having both X and Y

exposure.window: concept-years with t - F in [3, 5] and t <= 2015; finite values; X_c = mean

outcome.primary: Y_c = unweighted mean A_cont over MAIN-arm host entry events with kw5 (>= 5 partners) and e >= F + 6
outcome.source: exp_7 results/features_screen.parquet / sealed/heldout_features.parquet (pre-entry partner host share)
outcome.Y2: share of qualifying events with A_cont > 0.0237160265 (SCREEN MAIN main-arm kw5 event median, n=1745, frozen)
outcome.Y3: mean_A_cont of d3_concept_anchoring(_heldout).parquet as exported (all entries; timing overlap disclosed)

covariates.early_volume: log1p(mean yearly all-type c-papers over F..F+5) from dataset_5 concept_work x works publication_year
covariates.origin_groups: Physics&Astronomy (F31), Computer Science (F17), Materials/Chem/Eng (F25, F16, F22, F15), Mathematics (F26), Other; groups with < 5 concepts in a fold merge into Other; reference = largest group

statistic.primary: partial Spearman: average ranks of X and Y, OLS-residualised on [1, covariates], Pearson r of residuals

bootstrap.type: percentile concept bootstrap (BCa as sensitivity); ranks and residualisation recomputed per draw

statistic.mde: rho_MDE = tanh((1.645 + 0.842) * sqrt(1.06 / (n - 3 - k))), k = covariate columns

sensitivities.S1: X = mean closure_res (frozen exp_6 R1a residualisation) over the same window; complete case
sensitivities.S2: screen only: for concepts with an E_up onset (exp_5 labels_screen onset_E_up), X restricted to t < onset
sensitivities.S3: adds rank(H_W1 at the last finite year of the exposure window) as covariate
sensitivities.S4: Y = mean A_cont_ex over the same events
sensitivities.S7: EXPLORATORY: X = mean constraint; X = mean xcomm_exc (R1-8 reading at concept level)
sensitivities.S8: fold-pooled partial Spearman with a fold dummy (descriptive)
sensitivities.secondary_outcomes: Y2 and Y3 with the primary covariates
sensitivities.note: sensitivities are reported, never decision-making; S-level bootstrap B = 2000, permutations 10000

decision.KEPT: screen partial rho < 0 with permutation p < 0.05 AND held-out partial rho < 0 with p < 0.05
decision.SCREEN_ONLY: screen passes and held-out rho < 0 with p >= 0.05 (report as a lead; quote held-out MDE)
decision.NULL: screen fails (sentence dropped; two separate findings)
decision.REVERSED: either fold partial rho > 0 with 95% percentile CI excluding 0 (reported as tension; checked first)
decision.HELDOUT_OPPOSITE_SIGN: screen passes and held-out rho >= 0 with CI including 0 -> reported as SCREEN_ONLY (sign not replicated)
decision.sentence: 'one mechanism at two scales' kept only if KEPT
